title: One example reveals a hidden distinction

captions.physics: Creating an example of the process

meaning: A concrete example can release your shared view from an unnoticed assumption and bring the simple pleasure of clarity.
text: Sometimes you use the same word while imagining different events behind it. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests creating a concrete example and showing how each person understands what is happening. The Tower in energy supports a desire to uncover an unreliable assumption and build understanding without it. The Sun in emotions responds with the pleasure of clarity: something that tangled discussion becomes available to an ordinary explanation. The distinction itself can bring relief even before you have changed the usual sequence of actions.

Suppose you are gathering materials for a shared folder and make a sample entry on your list. You discover that “done” means a file has been sent to one person and already checked to the other. **Clarity appears when a shared word stops hiding two meanings.** Beyond another moment of confusion, you can name both stages. A small example reveals why you expected different continuations. The question gains a concrete explanation without requiring guesses about someone’s attentiveness.

The difficulty is deciding that misunderstanding can no longer arise after such a discovery. Wanting to preserve the lightness, you may find another clarification unnecessarily complicated. Interest in an honest foundation remains useful when it extends to fresh words too. A clear example serves its particular purpose; another question may still need a distinction of its own while leaving the pleasure of existing clarity intact.
